svg.title: D1MS2.2: native pad
svg.desc: a5984-stepper-driver source-derived candidate reference, not a qualified powered installation.

g.text: BoardMount holes are connected to GROUND
Adjust the potentiometer below each driver to set output current
Large resistors near the motor outputs are current sense resistors
MS1, MS2, MS3 Microstep select switches for each driver (D0, D1, D2) Short to pull high
